responsibility: Owns the compiled-in data tables that describe AVR core families and individual MCUs and provides small lookup/reporting helpers around them. It defines `avr_arch_types`, architecture texinfo descriptions, and the `avr_mcu_types` array generated from `avr-mcus.def`, so this file is the central runtime source for mapping `-mmcu` names to architecture capabilities, memory layout defaults, feature flags, and documentation text; it also supplies helper routines used both by the backend and by AVR generator programs to recognize core names and report supported architectures.
